title: Story premise ENT023: The Bridge of Pauses
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (cooperation). Hook: Every note makes the bridge shorter. Takeaway/theme: Leaving space can be an active contribution.
description: Two musicians must cross a fantasy bridge that grows only during silence, but each keeps filling the other’s pause. They establish a shared breath, wait together, and cross a bridge made from the quiet intervals they finally allow.
